description: A live session instrument for DeepSeek Harness: seven rings, a turn timeline, per-step ladders. Needs the dsh-visualization plugin installed and DSH running — the wallpaper talks to http://127.0.0.1:8799/, which the plugin opens on a fixed port. Noncommercial; visual language derived from HALOFLUX by Ryder191.
title: DSH Visualization
